plugin.name: Spyro Reignited Trilogy Widescreen Fix
OverrideFOV.description: A fixed horizontal field of view in degrees at 16:9, before the widescreen correction. -1 keeps the game's.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the camera's field of view, which already widens with the screen (Hor+). Scripted views use the same camera and change too.
